question: Can you help me calculate the average number of new unicorn companies per year in the top industry from 2019 to 2021?
sql:
-- Average number of new unicorn companies per year in Fintech from 2019 to 2021
-- (21 + 18 + 142) / 3 = 181 / 3 = 60.33
SELECT AVG(unicorn_count) as avg_new_unicorns_per_year
FROM (
    SELECT SUBSTR(cd.date_joined, 1, 4) as year_joined, COUNT(*) as unicorn_count
    FROM companies_dates cd
    JOIN companies_industries ci ON cd.company_id = ci.company_id
    JOIN companies_funding cf ON cd.company_id = cf.company_id
    WHERE ci.industry = 'Fintech'
      AND SUBSTR(cd.date_joined, 1, 4) IN ('2019', '2020', '2021')
      AND cf.valuation >= 1000000000
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(cd.date_joined, 1, 4)
)
